(7 matches) |matches = 171 |total goals = 324 |average attendance = 1,850 |prevseason = [[2022–23 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2022–23]] |nextseason = [[2024–25 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2024–25]] }} The '''2023–24 [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1]]''' (''Tunisian Professional League'') season was the 69th season of top-tier football in [[Tunisia]]. [[Étoile Sportive du Sahel|Étoile du Sahel]] were the defending champions from the previous season. On 15 June 2024, [[Espérance Sportive de Tunis|Espérance de Tunis]] were officially confirmed as champions with one game to spare following their 2–0 win against [[US Monastir (football)|US Monastir]], securing a record-extending 33rd title. ==Teams== 14 teams contested the league{{Cite web |title=Résultats et classement Tunisie Ligue 1 - Gr A 2023/2024 |url=https://www.kawarji.com/ligue-1/2023-2024 |access-date=2026-10-10 |website=www.kawarji.com}}{{Cite web |title=TUNISIA: Ligue Professionnelle 1 |url=https://www.flashscore.com/standings/O6NlCx61/dhGJsV9L/ |access-date=2026-10-10 |website=www.flashscore.com |language=en}}. {{Location map+ |Tunisia |width=280 |float=above |caption=Locations of the 2023–24 Ligue 1 teams
